faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.switchA: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade whenever you need — your data and account stay under your control throughout.
faq.businessA: Pro and Ultimate. Treasury, Approvals, Team, and Report are part of the web dashboard. Learn more on the {link} page.
faq.secureA: Yes. TrackFi uses zero access encryption — your financial records are encrypted on your device before sync, and Kura cannot read them.
